summary: Merged todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T031.md into a single unified contract body per Owner Decision 5. Removed the dual-layer expression: dropped the `> Contract status: FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778` marker and the `> Owner amendment (2026-09-16):` top block. Inlined the binding Owner direction into the Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References sections, and appended a `## Binding direction reference` audit-trail subsection that cites /tmp/owner_decision_T031.txt and lists the relevant Decision 2 and Decision 5 items. Per Decision 2, the Outcome now states explicitly that ADR-002 is accepted and is not reopened, that ADR-010 refines the field semantics of the two-layer structure (acquisition envelope vs normalized event identity / content hash), and that T031 owns the Parquet column / partition / manifest physical layout while T030 owns the logical schema. Deliverables now separate raw evidence columns, typed / normalized columns, acquisition envelope columns (endpoint alias, retrieval time, request interval, HTTP batch metadata), and schema / decode version columns, and split manifest accounting by endpoint alias, logical RPC calls, HTTP requests / batches, response bytes, normalized rows, provider units when reported, Parquet bytes, and explicit scanned-empty intervals. Acceptance now enumerates idempotent repeat / overlap, crash-at-boundary atomicity, manifest / corruption detection, cross-provider normalized content hash equality with both raw envelopes retained, dedup-by-EventKey-plus-normalized-content (not by ingestion time, endpoint, block number alone, or filename), retention and halt qualification of conflicting observations, and a representative short-range partition-sizing measurement that is not promoted to a universal constant. Must-not keeps the existing prohibitions (no mutate / delete of orphaned raw evidence, no half-written partitions, no filename-as-manifest) and adds prohibitions on reopening ADR-002 inside this task and on writing credential-bearing URLs into raw, normalized, manifest, or provenance storage. References stays at R13, ADR-002, ADR-010. No other files in docs/intent/, docs/spec/, other task contracts, workflow / controller code, agent definitions, or review records were touched, and todo/config.yaml was not modified.
rationale: The triage classified T031 as CONTRACT_MISMATCH because the task contract still carries the dual-layer expression introduced by the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment on top of the frozen baseline body. /tmp/owner_decision_T031.txt makes that amendment binding (Decision 5, preamble) and specifies exactly which clauses must land in the merged contract for T031 (Decision 2): ADR-002 stays accepted and is not reopened; ADR-010 is a field-semantics refinement on top of ADR-002; T031 owns the Parquet column / partition / manifest physical layout, not the logical schema that T030 owns; acquisition envelope / manifest carries endpoint alias, retrieval time, request interval, and HTTP batch metadata; normalized event identity and normalized content hash exclude those observational fields so the same chain event from A and B hashes equal while both raw envelopes are still retained and checksummed; manifest accounting is split across the listed counters including explicit scanned-empty intervals; dedup is by T011 EventKey + normalized content, not by ingestion time, endpoint, block number, or filename; and conflicting observations are retained and halt qualification instead of being silently overwritten. The merge satisfies all of those clauses by inlining them into the unified body and keeping the binding direction reference as a non-binding audit trail. The sibling T030 task (commit 9a44378) followed the same planning route and is now APPROVED at 870c07d; T031 follows the identical shape, with wording scoped to physical layout rather than logical schema so the two merged contracts are complementary, not duplicative. Only todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T031.md was modified; no schema.py, no other contracts, no workflow / controller code, no config.yaml, no evidence pointers, no commit SHAs, no approval data, and no runtime model were touched, matching the CONTRACT_MISMATCH scope rules.
